interpretation: A_D is the exact Maurer-Cartan form of multiplicative support; using it as a local representation connection is conditional on a G_D field action

laws.boundary_pullback: i*(D Phi)=D_boundary(i*Phi) when i is equivariant and A_D pulls back
laws.contraction: support weights add, including the weight of every inverse metric used in contraction
laws.curvature: F_D=dA_D=d^2 log(upsilon)=0 on each smooth regular chart
laws.fiber_integration: D_base pi_!(alpha)=pi_!(D alpha) only for basic A_D and an assigned fiber-measure character
laws.frozen_limit: upsilon=1 constant implies A_D=0 and D^(w)=nabla
laws.local_transformation: conditional local-frame test: upsilon->t upsilon; Phi_w->t^w Phi_w; A_D->A_D+d log(t)
laws.metric: D G=-w_G A_D tensor G for the Levi-Civita parent connection; metric compatibility occurs iff w_G=0
laws.tensor: D^(w1+w2)(Phi tensor Psi)=D^(w1)Phi tensor Psi+Phi tensor D^(w2)Psi
